title: Pakson’s Seaside Sports Day

timeline.speaker: narrator
timeline.text: Welcome to Pakson’s Seaside Sports Day! Pip is waiting by the running track. Come and see what the two friends can do together.

timeline.text: At the seaside sports ground, the flags fluttered in the breeze. Coach Otis called the friends over to warm up.

timeline.speaker: otis
timeline.text: Stretch one arm. Lift one leg. Tap one foot.

timeline.speaker: pakson
timeline.text: Tap, tap! Pip, your foot is keeping time.

timeline.text: It is! But what if I forget the steps when everyone is watching?
